# Vendored tree-sitter grammars

Generated by `scripts/vendor-grammars.sh` from `grammars.json`. Each directory keeps its upstream `LICENSE`.
Local query overrides in `Queries/` are part of QuickEdit. The runtime comes from SwiftPM dependencies:
SwiftTreeSitter (BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/ChimeHQ/SwiftTreeSitter) and tree-sitter (MIT,
https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter).
